evidence_quote: Enterprise password vault with automated rotation and encryption
notes: Secret Server Remote Password Changing (RPC) covers AD, service, local, and SSH accounts. AWS/Azure Secrets Manager sync added 2024.

evidence_quote: RDP and SSH sessions proxy through Secret Server vault
notes: Forced-proxy ensures no direct server access; sessions routed through vault enforcing credential injection.

evidence_quote: Record keystrokes and video for SQL RDP SSH PuTTY sessions
notes: Full keystroke and screen recording with searchable playback; keystroke search for sudo commands on SSH.

evidence_quote: Just-in-time access removes standing privilege after time limit
notes: Broker-and-remove workflow with approval, time-bound grant, and auto password rotation post-session. Delivered via Cloud Suite and Server PAM.

evidence_quote: Discover privileged accounts on systems devices and applications
notes: Service Account Discovery tool for Windows AD; Privilege Manager discovers machines and accounts with admin rights on endpoints.

evidence_quote: Applications retrieve passwords dynamically via PAM APIs
notes: AAPM and Delegated Machine Credentials (DMC) allow workloads to call vault APIs using machine OAuth2 token; removes hardcoded secrets.

evidence_quote: MFA enforcement on secrets via FIDO2 YubiKey mobile push
notes: Adaptive MFA for PAM; supports Delinea Mobile App, YubiKey/FIDO2, Microsoft Authenticator. MFA enforcement at depth announced 2023.

evidence_quote: Unlimited Administrator mode with dual-control and audit trail
notes: Break-glass via Unlimited Admin mode; requires dual-person approval, triggers email alert, full audit; resilient secrets provide offline cache.

evidence_quote: Endpoint least privilege and application control for Windows macOS
notes: Privilege Manager removes local admin rights, elevates per-application, enforces application control. Market-leading dedicated EPM product.

evidence_quote: Granular least-privilege JIT elevation for Linux UNIX Windows servers
notes: Server Suite / Cloud Suite enforces just-enough privilege per-command on Unix/Linux; Privilege Control for Cloud Entitlements right-sizes cloud entitlements.

evidence_quote: Browser-based VPN-less privileged remote access for vendors contractors
notes: Dedicated Privileged Remote Access product; JIT vaulted-credential injection, session recording, MFA, approval workflow for third parties.

evidence_quote: Discover and right-size entitlements across AWS Azure GCP
notes: Privilege Control for Cloud Entitlements (PCCE) — Microsoft-selected replacement for Entra Permissions Management (retired Oct 2025). Covers multi-cloud IAM.

evidence_quote: Machine identity OAuth2 token delegates workload vault access
notes: Delegated Machine Credentials use Cloud Suite agent footprint as machine identity; no per-workload service accounts; secretless credential brokering. Not full SPIFFE/SPIRE attestation.

evidence_quote: Automatically extract and correlate user and access data
notes: Fastpath Access Review (partner-integrated add-on): automated access certification workflows and remediation reporting. Not native to core Secret Server; requires Fastpath module.

evidence_quote: Detect deviations with dynamic baseline behavioral indicators
notes: Privileged Behavior Analytics (PBA) + Identity Threat Protection (ITP) via Authomize acquisition; AI-driven risk scoring across privileged identities.

evidence_quote: AI-driven auditing flags anomalies in privileged sessions
notes: AI-Driven Auditing analyses session recordings for anomalies; ITDR correlates behaviour across users tokens service accounts; patent-backed credential-sharing detection.

evidence_quote: Clustering resilient secrets SQL AlwaysOn for high availability
notes: Multi-node clustering, SQL AlwaysOn, RabbitMQ HA, resilient-secrets selective replication (on-prem to cloud). Cloud-hosted SaaS option removes most infra HA burden.
